name: Teens Leading Change (TLC)
org: City of Tampa Parks and Recreation
what_you_do: Weekly meetings, group talks, sports, art, life skills and community service projects at city rec centers. Trained leaders run them.
who_can_apply: Teens 13 to 19. A free Rec Card and program registration are required.
how_to_apply: Get a free Rec Card. Sign up. Visit a TLC site (for example Copeland Park Center, 813-975-2743).
notes: Programs build time management, team building and financial planning, per the page. Not a job.
